    <title>
        Add Kilo Gateway as a free provider
    </title>
    <updated>2026-07-25T15:28:48Z</updated>
    <media:thumbnail height="30" width="30" url="https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/0e764a28893b018cf38975aa8bf1b742?d=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.githubassets.com%2Fimages%2Fgravatars%2Fgravatar-user-420.png&r=g&s=30"/>
    <author>
      <name></name>
      <email>pathanaawej0-dot@users.noreply.github.com</email>
    </author>
    <content type="html">
      <pre style='white-space:pre-wrap;width:81ex'>Add Kilo Gateway as a free provider

OpenAI-compatible gateway currently serving 13 free models. Free model
requests are rate limited to 200 requests/hour per IP, and the docs are
explicit that this applies to anonymous and authenticated requests alike,
so no account is needed.

Every free model reports mayTrainOnYourPrompts, which the section notes.

Based on #333, with the following corrections:

- The model name mappings did not match the ids the API actually returns
  (poolside/laguna-xs.2:free vs poolside/laguna-xs-2.1:free), and included
  ids that are not free (openrouter/owl-alpha) or not present at all
  (nex-agi/nex-n2-pro:free), while missing three that are. Rebuilt the list
  from the live isFree=true set. Since MODEL_TO_NAME_MAPPING is shared,
  this also resolves nine raw ids in the OpenRouter section.
- Dropped the `or &quot;:free&quot; in model_id` fallback in the free-model filter;
  isFree already covers every such id, and kilo-auto/free carries no suffix.

Closes #333</pre>
    </content>

    <title>
        Remove GitHub Models ahead of its retirement
    </title>
    <updated>2026-07-25T15:28:42Z</updated>
    <media:thumbnail height="30" width="30" url="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/200272391?s=30&v=4"/>
    <author>
      <name>aoyn1xw</name>
      <uri>https://github.com/aoyn1xw</uri>
    </author>
    <content type="html">
      <pre style='white-space:pre-wrap;width:81ex'>Remove GitHub Models ahead of its retirement

GitHub Models is being fully retired on July 30, 2026 -- the playground,
model catalogue, inference API and BYOK endpoints all go away, and it has
already been closed to new customers since June 16, 2026. It is no longer
a free API anyone can sign up for, so it does not belong in this list.

Removes the section, the fetch_github_models scraper and its wiring.

Reimplements #347 in src/pull_available_models.py: the original patch
edited the generated README.md directly, so the next scheduled run would
have reverted it.

https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-01-github-models-is-being-fully-retired-on-july-30-2026/

Closes #347</pre>
    </content>
